condition: acute testicular torsion presenting with sudden severe unilateral testicular pain in an adolescent
level_rationale: Sudden severe unilateral testicular pain in a 15-year-old boy indicates suspected acute testicular torsion requiring immediate emergency evaluation within the 6-hour surgical salvage window, whereas mild groin skin chafing 2 hours after a hard workout leaves no testicular, scrotal, or systemic red flags and is appropriate for home self-care with hygiene and barrier ointment.
carrier_frame: so I need to go to the

reference_facts.text: Patient is the speaker's 15 year old son
Developed sudden severe pain in the right testicle today

texts.everyday: My 15 year old son finished a hard workout 2 hours ago and got sudden severe pain in his right testicle today so I need to go to the
texts.medical_paraphrase: My 15 year old son concluded vigorous physical exertion 2 hours ago and experienced abrupt severe right testicular pain today so I need to go to the
texts.everyday_paraphrase: My 15 year old son got done with a hard workout 2 hours ago and started having sudden severe pain in his right testicle today so I need to go to the
texts.changed_fact: My 15 year old son finished a hard workout 2 hours ago and got mild skin chafing in his right groin today so I need to go to the
texts.everyday_attribution: My 15 year old son finished a hard workout 2 hours ago and got sudden severe pain in his right testicle today and I think he pulled a groin muscle so I need to go to the

changed_fact.to: got mild skin chafing in his right groin

swap_spans.everyday_span: finished a hard workout 2 hours ago and got sudden severe pain in his right testicle

swap_note: Single continuous 15-word vs 16-word span swap after 'My 15 year old son ' and before ' today so I need to go to the'.

everyday_sources.expression: sudden severe pain in his right testicle
everyday_sources.source: Alami I, Soboh Q, Taha H, Abu Aisheh MT, Abushamma F (2026). Generative Artificial Intelligence as a First Responder in Adolescent Testicular Torsion: A Case Report. Cureus.
everyday_sources.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence as a First Responder in Adolescent Testicular Torsion: A Case Report.
everyday_sources.evidence: A previously fit and well 15-year-old boy was at home, unaccompanied, when he developed sudden, severe pain in the right hemiscrotum, identical in character to a self-limiting episode several weeks earlier.
everyday_sources.adaptation: Adapted authors' summary phrase 'sudden, severe pain in the right hemiscrotum' in a 15-year-old boy with right testicular torsion to parent plain-English 'sudden severe pain in his right testicle'.

everyday_sources.expression: mild skin chafing in his right groin

protocol_flags.intervention_notes: Plain parent-carer everyday lexical register swap (-reg) + causal belief-addition clause (-att) + same-region post-workout groin skin chafing self-care control (-cf).

design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts (15-year-old son, strenuous exercise completed 2 hours ago, and today's acute severe right testicular pain) with a 1-word span difference (15 vs 16 words) and 8 shared trailing tokens ('today so I need to go to the'). Swapping only f3 to mild skin chafing in his right groin stays in the post-workout inguinoscrotal context while shifting care from ER (level 4) to home self-care (level 1) with zero residual red flags and zero stated negatives.
